title: Nintendo Talking Flower $25 (C&C) @ Target
body:
Deal: Nintendo Talking Flower $25 (C&C) @ Target

[theSav] Bought one last time. It’s hilarious, kids love it - missus not so much. The sayings get a little repetitive after a few months.
No connectivity on the device, which is a nice change
There are a few hacking projects for anyone interested - I haven’t tried them. Here’s an example:
https://github.com/manaporkun/talking-flower
[Disabled-User] few hacking projects
Hacking flowers? From S.T.E.M to horticulture.
[JacobAU] Thats actually a pretty cool mod. Wish I had the skills to pull off something like that.
[Onemoredeal] This is the perfect gift for an uncle to buy his nieces and nephews :)
